links.outcome: ACP documentation and end-of-life care outcomes before vs after ML-triggered notification
links.effect: ACP documentation rose from 2.3% to 80.5% (P<0.001), but no differences in LOS, hospice referral, code status change, ICU admissions, 30-day readmissions, ED visits, or deaths.
links.quote: Identifying patients with cancer and high mortality risk via machine learning elicited a substantial increase in documented ACP conversations but did not impact EOL care.
